text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates. The Board also wishes to confirm that the following member, previously appointed by Community Council, continue to serve on the Board for the term of office noted below and until a successor is appointed: Ralph Daley, for a term of office ending June 24, 2021.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the individuals listed below to the Board, at pleasure of Council, for the a term of office ending June 23, 2022, and until successors are appointed: Lynn Daly Richard Kang Choo Laura Mandelbaum Serena Purdy
